comment: Catalog of tools/models/convert.ps1 (contract 'geo', unit F2). 'layers': every model layer upstream registers in ClientRegistrationEvents.registerLayerDefinitions (the converter fails on a missing one) with its owning unit (rule R3), the ids it serves (checked against docs/spec/owners.tsv), its textures (paths below upstream's assets/gloamingforest/textures/, 'minecraft:' = vanilla) and the class whose setupAnim becomes the base animation. kind: entity (default) | block | item (block entity / item models, no animation) | armor (written per slot by 'armor') | source (used by 'extracts' only); vanilla: the layer is a vanilla Minecraft model, use that Bedrock geometry; skip: not drawn. 'armor': armor and Travellers' Gear attachables (bones carry the player's bone names). 'extracts': parts drawn with a renderer's PoseStack transforms (trophies on blocks; worn and held items); 'opChains' are shared PoseStack transform chains (translate in blocks, rotations in degrees, as upstream's renderers apply them); ['display', <context>] is the display transform (ItemTransform) of the extract's upstream item model (models/item/<item>.json and its parents, read from the upstream checkout). An extract with 'item' and 'forms' is written once per form of 'itemForms' (<name>_worn on the head, <name>_held in the right hand, <name>_held_left in the left hand) and gets one attachable with the geometry of every form, drawn in its slot (c.item_slot). Pose expressions may use ageInTicks (0 in the geometry); with 'animation' they also become a base animation. See docs/spec/models.md.

baseCase.comment: The value entity or model state has on the base path of setupAnim -> Molang (docs/spec/models.md): the state upstream's mobs are in most of the time, instead of 'a condition that does not translate counts as false'. scope: a class of the model's chain (an upstream model class, its vanilla base, 'HumanoidModel' / 'QuadrupedModel' for those families) or '*'; expr: the Java expression ('entity' = the entity parameter, 'this.' = a field or method of the model, '(*)' = any arguments); value: a number, true / false, an enum constant ('Type.NAME') or null; fixed: upstream never changes it (comparisons fold to a constant and leave no case entry; the bone map notes the value); otherwise the statements that use it are case entries whose 'affects' names the channels that differ in the other states; why: the upstream code it comes from.

values.why: the Jappa models belong to an optional resource pack upstream does not ship; not ported (docs/spec/README.md)

extracts.name: knight_phantom_trophy
notes: KnightPhantomModel.renderTrophy draws the helmet with phantom_layer_1 and the vertex colour FastColor.ARGB32.colorFromFloat(0.0625F, 1, 1, 1) under RenderType.entityCutoutNoCull. That alpha has no visible effect: the 1.21.1 shader rendertype_entity_cutout_no_cull.fsh discards on the texture alpha alone (< 0.1) before it multiplies the vertex colour, and the render type draws without blending, so the horned helmet shows opaque over the phantomskeleton head (block, wall and item forms, GUI included). phantom_layer_1 has only alpha 0 and 255, so entity_alphatest matches it exactly.
